/usr/bin/cmake -E rm -f CMakeFiles/test_bitcoin-qt.dir/objects.a
x86_64-w64-mingw32-ar qc CMakeFiles/test_bitcoin-qt.dir/objects.a @CMakeFiles/test_bitcoin-qt.dir/objects1.rsp
/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++-posix -O2 -O2 -g -static -Wl,--major-subsystem-version,6 -Wl,--minor-subsystem-version,2 -fstack-reuse=none -fstack-protector-all -fcf-protection=full -Wl,--enable-reloc-section -Wl,--dynamicbase -Wl,--nxcompat -Wl,--high-entropy-va -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--whole-archive CMakeFiles/test_bitcoin-qt.dir/objects.a -Wl,--no-whole-archive -o ../../../bin/test_bitcoin-qt.exe -Wl,--out-implib,../../../lib/libtest_bitcoin-qt.dll.a -Wl,--major-image-version,0,--minor-image-version,0 @CMakeFiles/test_bitcoin-qt.dir/linkLibs.rsp
